scope: Read-only source review; not boot, syscall, sysfs access or task lifecycle validation.

evidence.excerpt:
priority -20
    socket zygote_next seqpacket 660 root system
    disabled
    onrestart setprop zygote.zygote_next.server_ready false

on boot && property:persist.zygote.zygote_next.start_on_boot=true
    start zygote_next

onrestart setprop zygote.zygote_next.server_ready false

on boot && property:persist.zygote.zygote_next.start_on_boot=true
    start zygote_next

# Should be before netd, but after apex, properties and logging is available.
    trigger load-bpf-programs

    # Now we can start zygote.
    trigger zygote-start

# Now we can start zygote.
    trigger zygote-start

    # Remove a file to wake up anything waiting for firmware.
    trigger firmware_mounts_complete

# It is recommended to put unnecessary data/ initialization from post-fs-data
# to start-zygote in device's init.rc to unblock zygote start.
on zygote-start
    wait_for_prop odsign.verification.done 1
    start statsd
    start zygote
    start zygote_secondary

service lmkd /system/bin/lmkd
    class core
    user lmkd
    group lmkd system readproc
    capabilities DAC_OVERRIDE KILL IPC_LOCK SYS_NICE SYS_RESOURCE
    critical
    socket lmkd seqpacket+passcred 0660 system system

class core
    user lmkd
    group lmkd system readproc
    capabilities DAC_OVERRIDE KILL IPC_LOCK SYS_NICE SYS_RESOURCE
    critical
    socket lmkd seqpacket+passcred 0660 system system
    task_profiles ServiceCapacityLow
